description: Active Amount Off Order promotion with a normal coupon code on the store and coupons left to apply, taking a flat discountAmount off the order. KB: Managing Promotions and Coupons (Amount Off Order; Coupon Code; Available Quantity); Configuring a Promotion.

redemptionsNeeded.description: Orders the test places with the coupon (minimum 1: the coupon must have a use left to apply)

discountAmount.description: Flat amount the coupon takes off the order total

store.description: Store code the promotion applies to

now.description: System param: evaluation time, filled in by the profiler or resolver; tests do not set it
